msg: 2 dives. price if we stay at Majagua?
reply:
Since you’ll be staying at San Pedro de Majagua, the *2-dive Fun Dives trip* is available with direct pickup from the hotel. The two dives are at different sites and last 40–50 minutes each.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• Fun Dives - 1 dive (1 day): 97 USD · 108 USD (345.000 COP · 383.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD (665.000 COP · 739.000 COP)

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?
